name: Miso
description: An AI app that creates meal menus for you. There are many apps rapidly growing with this theme. You can incorporate menus that are buzzing on social media like Instagram.
ux_highlights: First, a series of Yes/No questions that make users aware of their challenges rather than asking questions directly. The onboarding clearly explains how to use the app's signature feature: "Importing menus from social media." Users can experience the actual menu generation process firsthand. Toward the end, there is a commitment button where users long-press to boil a pot.
monetization: With the annual plan offer, you can choose between a 3-day free trial and a 30-day trial for 500 yen.
